name: ai-orchestrator
description: AI Orchestrator - Intelligent Business Workflow Orchestration Platform

scripts.install:all: cd server && cmd /c npm install && cd ../client && cmd /c npm install
scripts.dev: cmd /c npm run dev:server & cmd /c npm run dev:client
scripts.dev:server: cd server && cmd /c npm run dev
scripts.dev:client: cd client && cmd /c npm run dev
scripts.build: cd server && cmd /c npm run build && cd ../client && cmd /c npm run build
